# OP_RETURN / OP-20

> OP_RETURN gives compact data a permanent place in Bitcoin history. OP-20 turns those messages into a community-readable world of deploys, mints, and transfers.

## Public experience

- Home: https://bitcoinuniverse.github.io/op-return/
- Discover: https://bitcoinuniverse.github.io/op-return/reference.html
- Get started: https://bitcoinuniverse.github.io/op-return/guide.html
- Bitcoin Universe: https://inscribe.bitcoinuniverse.io/

## The experience

- Carry: Place concise data in a Bitcoin transaction with OP_RETURN.
- Coordinate: Use OP-20 actions to express a token’s supply, mints, and movement.
- Remember: Follow the confirmed transaction and its interpreted history over time.

## In plain language

- The carrier: OP_RETURN stores provably unspendable data in a Bitcoin output.
- The language: OP-20 recognizes deploy, mint, and transfer actions.
- The identity: Tickers are compared without letter-case differences.
- The view: Compatible services interpret OP-20 activity from confirmed transactions.

## User safety

OP-20 balances are interpreted by compatible services and are separate from Bitcoin’s native consensus rules. Always review the exact payload, recipient, and fees before signing.
